Name: (CP) Linus in Shipping Bin
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][b]Updated for 1.6![/b][/size]

Want to have Linus live on your farm, but he won't move into a shed? No problem! Just have him settle into your shipping bin. He'll pop out when you throw in an item to sell it for you! (Doesn't even take a cut, what a nice guy~)


~~

Inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/65]JG Demetrius in Shipping Box mod[/url], this mod adds Linus into your shipping bin. When you ship an item, he'll pop out and back inside. Purely cosmetic and for fun; rest assured that your products and profits are entirely safe.

Works with buildable shipping bins around the farm, and overlays over other shipping bin colors--like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1554]Eemie's Dark Wood[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1904]my Burnt Sienna[/url]~

Note however that this mod does [b]not [/b]work with anything that affects the shipping bin animation itself--such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]﻿. 

[b]To install--[/b]
[b]1.[/b] Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[b]2.[/b] Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
[b]3. [/b]Load up your game and say hi to Linus~!

Check out some other fun character-in-shipping-bin mods here!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/65]JG Demetrius in Shipping Box mod (the one that started it all~)[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1849]Pam in Shipping Bin by yours truly[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1852]Morris in Shipping Bin by Fynzou[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1865]Junimo in Your Shipping Box by megmom84[/url]﻿[/font]
